headline: Small SE leftovers with a glassy morning window — log it before the sea breeze fills in.
today: Waist-high SE at 6.5s, fair angle, nothing to write home about but rideable. Your window is the morning around that 4mph SSW glass-off before the SSE onshore stacks up in the afternoon and turns it into slop. Bring the log or a groveler and work the tide either side of the midday high.

daysToWatch.note: Biggest day of the stretch, building to 4ft-plus. Morning is cross-on but the wind swings WNW cross-off in the afternoon — aim for that window with a shortboard.
Clean dawn with light NNW offshore and chest-high SSE still around. Get in early before the SE cross-on builds.
Onshore S wind all day on a short-period swell. Junky, skip it.
